name: Alex Cissell
fact: Cissell was still authoring SGA legislation two sessions after her committee chairmanship: she wrote the 2023-24 Hope Harbor X Denim Day funding bill and presented it to the senate on 12 March 2024 with Senator at Large Sophia Bryant, by then a senior public relations student. The Herald photograph of that presentation shows a woman; the archive's 2021-22 profile paragraph refers to Cissell as "he", which appears to be an unsourced inference and should be checked.
